model.scope: Synthetic shifted PSK+chirp distribution: SNR10..30dB, SIR-12..8dB, RRC rolloff.35, 8 samples/symbol, recorded CFO/timing/multipath distributions in synthetic.py. Raw received target waveform error, no alignment.
model.scale: mean per-sample variance across three hybrid training seeds +0.01*mixture power

limitations: Only a finite synthetic marginal-coverage test; no real-RF coverage guarantee.
Same-model errors may be correlated. A numerical interval is not evidence of identifiability.
